method.indexText: Recursively concatenate string values of object properties named en. Search stems, options, rationales and other English fields; do not search IDs or metadata as clinical evidence.
method.caseContext: Case aggregates include shared exhibits/stages and embedded English text. Their hit counts overlap leaf hits and must not be added.
method.retrieval: Python re.search(pattern, row["text_en"], re.IGNORECASE). Exact expressions and every matching ID are retained below; intersection expressions retain their original flags.
method.judgment: Read full nearby question content and relevant parent context before retaining a candidate; retrieval counts alone do not establish semantic absence.
limitations: Bounded semantic discovery, not exhaustive coverage certification.
Canonical membership is not a new correctness or review-eligibility verdict.
No bilingual clinical-parity review was performed for this discovery task.
All analytical seats are within the GPT/Astra producing team, not the required independent checker.
